description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lu (English UK, LANGID 0x0809) read-only. On table-type recordsets, Seek with each of = >= > <= < for every distinct stored value of the pair corpus (one Null, one empty) and five absent keys (aaa, az, ca, zzz, a symbol) on IX_K, and for every third distinct value plus the absent keys on IX_KD, reading NoMatch and the ID of the current record after each. Asks which row each operator selects under this locale on an ascending and a descending index, for present, absent, Null and empty keys.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
